# SpeedCheck — Free Instant Internet Speed Test

> SpeedCheck is a free internet speed test that measures your download speed, upload speed, and latency (ping) in under 30 seconds using Cloudflare's global edge network spanning 330+ cities. No signup required — the test starts automatically when you open the page.

## Key Facts

- **Free**: 100% free with no subscription, no credit card, and no ads.
- **No signup**: Use instantly without creating an account or logging in.
- **Cloudflare edge network**: Powered by Cloudflare's anycast edge network spanning 330+ cities worldwide for real-world performance without ISP caching.
- **Metrics measured**: Measures download speed (Mbps), upload speed (Mbps), latency/ping (ms), and loaded latency (bufferbloat in ms).
- **Auto-start**: The speed test starts automatically the moment you open the page — zero clicks required.

## Pages

- [SpeedCheck](https://speedcheck.solverspro.com): Minimalist, instant-start speed test that auto-starts on load and displays download speed with optional latency and upload details.
- [Advanced Speed Test](https://speed.solverspro.com): Comprehensive network diagnostic tool featuring an interactive speedometer gauge, jitter analysis, bufferbloat grading, and experience quality scores for gaming, streaming, and video calls.
